steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the direct event flow.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation so publishing is available.
Set the event type to RFQ and configure whole-lot awarding.

args.title: SRC-E2E-017 Direct RFQ Award to L1

steps.note: Provide the required event title.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the sourcing sheet is available.
Add the specified product and set its requested quantity to 10.
Verify the requested product was selected.
Verify the product's default variant is populated as Variant 1.
Verify the requested quantity is 10.
Complete remaining required pricing-sheet fields before scheduling and publishing.
Set the requested delivery location.
Verify the delivery location was retained.
Invite two QA vendors for the two required competing bids.
Commit the 30-minute schedule with the event starting now.
Publish the configured single-stage RFQ.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Submit Vendor A's quote of 100 using the first invited vendor position.
Verify the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's lower quote of 90 using the second invited vendor position.
Verify the second vendor bid was accepted.
Wait for the bidding window to close before awarding.
Award the entire lot to the lowest bidder, Vendor B.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted award proposal as the pending buyer approver.
Complete PO creation from the approved award.
Verify exactly one PO line was created for the full quantity of 10.
Verify Recreate Order remains available for the completed direct event.
Return to the events list to verify the event moved to History.
Open the History tab.
Verify this plan's completed event appears in History.
